# Privacy Notice

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PrivacyNotice>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

A human- or machine-readable privacy notice informing data subjects about the processing of their personal data — the information-object counterpart of a [dpv:PrivacyNotice](https://w3id.org/dpv#PrivacyNotice) / [schema:PrivacyPolicy.](https://schema.org/PrivacyPolicy.) It may be attached to a [`RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) or to the entity whose data is governed.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
